headline: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI's safety committee; DeepSeek opens V4.1-Flash
body: A calmer day with partial recovery. Loss-of-control researcher Paul Christiano joined the OpenAI Foundation board and its safety committee, a small boost to Alignment & Control that trimmed Conquerors and Zookeeper. DeepSeek's MIT-licensed V4.1-Flash release eased Power Concentration, helping Libertarian Utopia. But an Anthropic scenario in which labour's share of income falls from about 60% to 45% weighed on Shared Prosperity and Egalitarian Utopia, offset by Suno paying rightsholders under its new licensed model. Horizon Balance rose to -3.56;
movers_note: Zookeeper -0.2, mostly from fading earlier news (-0.08) and DeepSeek's open V4.1-Flash (-0.07). Libertarian Utopia +0.2, mostly from DeepSeek's open V4.1-Flash (+0.10) and Christiano's appointment (+0.06). Conquerors -0.2, from Christiano's appointment (-0.08) and fading earlier news (-0.08).
